_comment: `main`/`types` point straight at the TS source rather than a `build/` output. This module only ever runs inside the Ampora Metro bundle (never published, never installed by npm) so there is no separate compile step to keep in sync -- Metro/Babel transform it exactly like every other file under native/modules/** the moment IGNITION_NATIVE is on. Discovered by Expo autolinking via the `expo-module.config.json` next to this file, under the nativeModulesDir the root package.json declares (./native/modules).
